name: analyze
summary: Deterministic document-approval fixture: returns fixed analysis fields, does not read the submitted document.
description: Reference/fixture implementation for doc-approval reference clients. IMPORTANT: this artifact is a fixed-output deterministic fixture -- it does not read or process the `document` input at all; every call returns the same hardcoded docType/parties/amounts/confidence/recommendation values regardless of what document is submitted. It is a genuine, real WASI binary (not a placeholder stub sharing a digest with unrelated capabilities), useful for proving the registry/artifact-hosting/execution pipeline end-to-end, but it does not perform real document analysis. Tracked follow-up for real per-input logic: registry#79.

preconditions.description: The caller provides a document string. It is accepted but not read by this fixture implementation.

postconditions.description: The capability returns a fixed docType, parties, amounts, confidence, and recommendation value, identical for every call regardless of the input document.

side_effects.description: Produces one fixed, deterministic output payload; does not depend on the provided document.
